spec.scope: Generic ATK stat on self (not attack-scoped, not crit-scoped).
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' + 'once per battle' = permanent passive; only terminated by the γ-removal line (ally out of action), which is unreachable in v1 (no ally ever dies), so effectively whole-fight.
spec.triggerIdentity: passive (start of battle, once per battle).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoding a finite durationSec (treating 'once per battle' as a one-shot timed buff), or casterAtkPct flat-add instead of atkPct self-scaling.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply at frame 0 with stat 'atkPct', value 58.08 (raw pct, not flat-resolved), targetSlug 'mana', and no in-fight expiry (expiresFrame absent/≥ fight length). Red under a timed or flat-ATK encoding.
spec.inertness: Must not apply to any ally; only mana's own damage moves when patched off.

spec.kitLine: in Metal γ, 10 normal attacks → heal
spec.scope: Normal attacks only feed the counter (skill/burst/DoT hits must not count).
spec.durationSemantics: Instant heal event per activation (ticks:1); repeats every 10 rounds indefinitely.
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:10 (counts ROUNDS; AR hitsPerShot 1 so 10 pulls = 10 hits). Metal-γ gate is inert in v1 (γ never removed since no ally dies) — acceptable to omit the gate, but the hitCount trigger itself is mandatory.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Dropped entirely as 'defensive, no damage'. This is the classic tandem trap: a heal event is the food for any teammate's 'recovery' trigger — crown ('when recovery takes effect') sits in the control comp, so at AR cadence (~12 pulls/s) this emits a recovery event roughly every 0.9s and keeps crown's on-recovery consumers permanently refreshed.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Under controlComp('mana'): recovery events targeting all 5 units at a rate of ~1 per 10 mana shot events, and crown's recovery-triggered buffApply count collapses when this block is deleted via withPatchedOverride('mana', …). Red if the heal is skipped or keyed to interval/lastBullet.
spec.inertness: Must add zero damage directly (heal models no HP-to-damage path for mana herself); mana's own totalDamage unchanged when patched off — only crown-side buffs may move.

spec.scope: Fires only when an ally is out of action — unreachable in v1 (boss deals no damage, no unit dies).
spec.triggerIdentity: ally-death event (no engine primitive; correctly unreachable).
spec.targetSet: 1 incapacitated ally, highest final ATK, except self.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Inventing a proxy trigger for it (interval/FB) — any modeling at all is wrong here.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: No block for this line exists; no events attributable to it in any run.
spec.inertness: Whole line must be inert; belongs verbatim in unmodeled.

spec.kitLine: ally out of action → Removes Metal γ
spec.scope: Only strips the γ status (and with it the 58.08% ATK).
spec.triggerIdentity: ally-death event — unreachable in v1, so γ (and the ATK buff) is legitimately permanent in-sim.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Modeling the ATK buff as removable/timed to 'account for' this line — in v1 the removal never fires, so any haircut on the 58.08% is an invented fudge.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: The skill1 atkPct 58.08 buff persists to the final frame of a 180s run (no mid-fight removal, no buffRemove).
spec.inertness: Line must move nothing; record verbatim in unmodeled.

spec.scope: Burst gauge generation only (burstGenPct) — must not touch damage buckets.
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' WHILE σ is held — NOT unconditionally permanent. σ is consumed at the first σ-gated Full Burst entry (skill2 line 2) and regained only via the own-burst-cast line (skill2 line 4). Faithfully encodable with the existing schema: resource pool (initial 1, max 1) + perResource burstGenPct buff + resource delta -1 on the σ-consuming FB block + delta +1 on a burstCast block.
spec.triggerIdentity: passive at battle start; live value tracks the σ pool.
spec.nearestWrongModel: A plain always-on passive burstGenPct 70.4 that ignores the consume/regain cycle — over-credits gauge generation during every FB window after σ is consumed, and over-credits the whole rest of the fight in any stretch where mana failed to re-cast her burst (helm co-B3 rotations in the control comp).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Gauge-generation rate (or time-to-gauge-full) during the 10s after a σ-consuming FB entry, before her σ-regain fires, is measurably lower than under an always-on patch; with the regain line deleted via withPatchedOverride, all FBs after the first arrive later (rotation stretches). Red under the ungated-passive encoding.
spec.inertness: Zero direct damage; only rotation/FB timing moves.

spec.kitLine: FB enter in σ: AD ▲21.12, ATK ▲63.36
spec.scope: Attack Damage (Damage Up bucket, attackDamagePct 21.12) + generic atkPct 63.36 — two separate effects, both self.
spec.durationSemantics: Both 'for 10 sec' = durationSec 10, wall-clock. Plus a σ-consume side effect (resource delta -1) at the same activation.
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter (ANY team FB) — but HARD-GATED on mana currently holding Metal σ (resourceGate min:1 on the σ pool, or the ownBurstGate approximation). Critically this is NOT burstCast: the buff keys to FB entry, at full FB-state.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Ungated fullBurstEnter — procs on EVERY team FB. This diverges exactly in the control comp, where helm is a co-B3: on rotations helm bursts (mana had cast nothing since her σ was consumed), σ is absent and the buffs must NOT apply. Second-nearest wrong: keying to burstCast, which fires pre-FB and drops the first FB's guaranteed proc semantics.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: In controlComp('mana') with helm co-B3: buffApply {stat:'attackDamagePct', value:21.12} + {stat:'atkPct', value:63.36} on FB entries where mana held σ (always the first FB — initial σ — and each FB following a mana burst cast), and NO such buffApply on an FB entered without σ. Count of these buffApply pairs < count of fullBurstStart events is the red/green discriminator vs the ungated model.
spec.inertness: Never applies to allies; never procs mid-window off a second stage cast.

spec.scope: Charge-time reduction only — a weapon-state modifier (taxonomy 6: it changes shots fired for a charge weapon), not a damage stat.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec 10 per FB entry, repeating every FB (this ■ is NOT σ-gated — read literally, it fires on every Full Burst entry).
spec.targetSet: 1 ally with the longest BASIC charge time — a target primitive the schema does not have (no alliesLongestChargeTime); in the fixed control comp this deterministically resolves to helm (SR, the only charge weapon among liter/crown/helm).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Three plausible misreads: (a) silently dropping it as 'ally QoL, no damage' — wrong, faster charge = more helm shots; (b) applying it to self (mana is AR, chargeFrames 0 — fully inert, masking the loss); (c) encoding the flat 0.18 sec as chargeSpeedPct 18 (misreading a flat-seconds value as a percentage).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: helm's shot cadence (shot events per second) rises during each 10s post-FB-entry window relative to a patch with this block removed, while liter/crown/mana cadence is untouched. A flat-0.18s-faithful conversion: the applied chargeSpeedPct must equal 0.18/basicChargeTime(helm)×100 (⚑ conversion recipe), not a literal 18.
spec.inertness: Zero effect on non-charge units; zero effect in any comp with no charge weapon.

spec.kitLine: cast Burst before FB ends → Metal σ
spec.scope: Re-grants the σ status (i.e., re-arms the 70.4% burstGenPct and re-opens the FB-entry buff gate). No direct damage.
spec.durationSemantics: σ 'continuously' until next consumed at a σ-gated FB entry.
spec.triggerIdentity: Condition = the skill user cast her OWN Burst Skill before that Full Burst ends. Her B3 cast precedes FB entry, so on any rotation mana bursts, σ is back by that FB's end — meaning gauge-refill windows retain the 70.4% as long as she keeps bursting, and the NEXT FB entry re-procs the AD/ATK pair. Encodable as burstCast → resource delta +1 (clamped at max 1). This is emphatically NOT fullBurstEnter: an FB completed by helm must not regrant σ.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Keying the regain to fullBurstEnter/fullBurstEnd unconditionally — every FB regrants σ, collapsing the whole σ economy into 'buffs every FB' regardless of who bursts. In the control comp with helm co-B3 that over-credits both the FB-entry buff frequency and the gauge speed.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Sequence assertion over the event log: after an FB whose rotation caster was helm (no mana burstCast event since her last σ consume), the NEXT fullBurstStart has NO {atkPct:63.36} buffApply; after an FB where a mana burstCast event occurred, the next fullBurstStart DOES. Green only under own-cast keying.
spec.inertness: No damage event of its own; no effect on allies.

spec.scope: SCOPED: sustainedDamagePct — boosts ONLY sustained-flavored damage. Her sole sustained source is her own burst DoT (next line), so this line exists to amplify those 10 ticks and nothing else.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec 10 — exactly spans the DoT's 10 ticks when cast together.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (her own burst; B3, cd 40s). Not fullBurstEnter.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Generic attackDamagePct 52.8 — over-credits ALL of mana's damage (normals + core hits) for 10s instead of only the DoT ticks. The taxonomy-1 scope trap in its damage-flavor form.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: During the 10s after her burst cast, mana's normal-attack damage-event mults are UNCHANGED when this block is toggled via withPatchedOverride, while the sustained DoT tick values scale by ×1.528 (relative to a patch with the buff deleted). Red under the generic-bucket encoding (normals would move).
spec.inertness: Normal/core buckets and all allies must not move.

spec.scope: Skill damage in the sustained flavor; never core (DoTs are never core-boosted); crit OFF by default (dot crit is opt-in measured-only).
spec.durationSemantics: A timed DoT: durationSec 10, intervalSec 1 → exactly 10 ticks per cast. One independent instance per burst cast is CORRECT here (10s ≪ the ~40s+ burst period, no overlap) — the taxonomy-5 continuous-DoT trap does not apply.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast. Per rule 9, burst-cast instant damage is FB-exempt, but these ticks LAND during the FB window — FB major by landing timing (default ON) is the expected treatment; noFb would need a measurement to set.
spec.targetSet: enemy (1 unit nearest crosshair = the boss).
spec.nearestWrongModel: A single flatDamage hit of 3960% at cast (collapsing the tick structure — wrong FB/buff snapshotting per tick), or flavor omitted (decoupling it from the 52.8% Sustained buff so the two lines silently stop interacting).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Per mana burstCast event: exactly 10 damage events with flavor/bucket 'sustained', mult 396, spaced 1s apart, none with core applied; their per-tick values reflect the co-active sustainedDamagePct 52.8 (ticks shrink ×1/1.528 when the burst self-buff is patched out). Red under single-hit, unflavored, or wrong-interval encodings.
spec.inertness: No extra instances between casts; zero ticks after t=cast+10s.

skill1: Activates if the skill user is in Metal γ status when an ally is out of action. Resurrect with 96% HP.
Activates when an ally is out of action. Affects self. Removes Metal γ.

notes: Expected shared-prior misreads to check hardest: (1) The σ economy is the unit's core mechanic and the control comp is adversarial to it — helm is a co-B3, so 'fullBurstEnter, ungated' for the AD/ATK pair and 'any-FB regain' for σ both over-credit exactly there; the faithful encoding is expressible today via a resource pool (initial 1, max 1) + resourceGate on the FB-entry block + burstCast regain + perResource burstGenPct. A pure ownBurstGate:'cast' approximation is close but MISSES the guaranteed first-FB proc from the initial σ when helm happens to burst first — assert FB1 procs unconditionally. (2) The hitCount-10 heal must not be dropped as defensive: crown's on-recovery trigger sits in the control fixture and at AR cadence the heal re-fires ~every 0.9s, so it is a live cross-unit damage channel (taxonomy 4). (3) The Charge Time ▼0.18 SEC line is a GAP twice over — no longest-basic-charge-time target primitive and the value is flat seconds, not a percent; in the fixed control comp it deterministically lands on helm (only charge weapon), and any chargeSpeedPct stand-in must use the 0.18/basicChargeTime conversion (⚑), never a literal 18. It is also NOT σ-gated, unlike the buff block above it — the two adjacent FB-enter blocks have different gates. (4) Burst 'Sustained Damage ▲' is flavor-scoped to her own DoT, not a generic Damage Up. (5) σ removal at FB entry also silently turns OFF the 70.4% gauge speed for the FB window until her regain — an always-on burstGenPct is the nearest-wrong for rotation timing. Timing caveat the driver must reconcile: the exact frame σ is regained (at her cast vs at FB end) changes whether a mana-cast FB's own entry re-consumes σ; the kit text ('before Full Burst ends') supports regain landing within that same FB window, so consecutive mana-cast rotations proc every FB — an encoding where back-to-back mana bursts fail to proc alternate FBs is a red flag.
